_readme: Traits are the heart of the game. Add one by copying a block and giving it a new id. 'effects' are interpreted generically by scripts/systems/skill_check.gd and scripts/systems/effect_resolver.gd - see docs/CONTENT_EDITING.md for every legal effect type. 'contexts' match the tags on an encounter choice; an empty list means 'always applies'.

traits.name: Strong as Hell
traits.description: +2 Strength on anything involving pushing, pulling, or ruining a door.

traits.name: Butterfingers
traits.description: Failed actions have a nasty habit of also costing money.

traits.name: Nobody Suspects Grandma
traits.description: Generates far less Heat on social and stealth work. Who would suspect?

traits.name: Keyboard Warrior
traits.description: +2 Intelligence on anything with a screen, a cable, or a beep.

traits.name: Loudmouth
traits.description: Social actions hit harder. Social failures are heard three floors up.

traits.name: Lucky Idiot
traits.description: Sometimes converts a clean failure into an unearned success.

traits.name: Claustrophobic
traits.description: Significantly worse in tunnels, vents, and anything shaped like a coffin.

traits.name: Professional Liar
traits.description: +2 Charisma when deceiving, which is most of the time.

traits.name: Walking Alarm
traits.description: Generates extra Heat on absolutely everything. Squeaky shoes.

traits.name: Gym Bro
traits.description: Permanently gains Strength after each successful physical action. Gains.

traits.name: Knows a Guy
traits.description: Successful actions occasionally shake loose some cash.

traits.name: Greased Up
traits.description: +2 Stealth and +1 Speed. Impossible to hold onto. Unpleasant to be near.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.description: Takes one less point of damage from everything, including the cafeteria.

traits.name: Overconfident
traits.description: Bigger critical successes. Also bigger critical disasters.

traits.name: Knows the Building
traits.description: +10% on every check performed indoors. Which is all of them. He's a janitor.

traits.name: Brittle
traits.description: Takes one extra point of damage. Made largely of cartilage and regret.

traits.name: Slippery Customer
traits.description: Critical failures are far less likely. Somehow always lands on his feet.

traits.name: Night Owl
traits.description: +15% on checks once the prison is on High Alert. Thrives in chaos.

traits.name: Morning Person
traits.description: +12% on checks while Heat is low. Falls apart under pressure.

traits.name: Medically Trained
traits.description: +3 Intelligence on medical work. Heals a little of everyone's dignity.

traits.name: Born in a Tunnel
traits.description: +20% on anything underground. Deeply strange about it.

traits.name: Kleptomaniac
traits.description: Steals something on every success. Steals something on every failure too.

traits.name: Unreasonably Calm
traits.description: Reduces all Heat this character generates by a quarter. Nothing fazes him.

traits.name: Bad Knees
traits.description: -2 Speed. Will mention the knees at every opportunity.

traits.name: Eats Anything
traits.description: Critical successes become more common. Nobody understands why.

traits.name: Tattooed Map
traits.description: Has the prison layout on his back. +12% on technical and planning checks.

traits.name: Allergic to Guards
traits.description: Sneezes near authority. -12% on social checks, and everyone hears it.

traits.name: Fast Hands
traits.description: +2 Speed and +1 Stealth on anything requiring a quick grab.
